currentHttpTests.scope: Actual local HTTP/process tests on Windows for current source and freshly extracted complete package. No browser, external network, original executable or physical macOS test.

limits: A complete gameplay or visual 1:1 recreation is not achieved; this is an intermediate checkpoint.
Current simulation still uses consistent BASE data. A separate installed-UP15 profile is being reconstructed outside this checkpoint.
Complete native roster, AI, civilizations, weather, lighting, terrain generation and special abilities remain incomplete.
Native water base material, separate reflection visibility and full transparent/shadow ordering remain incomplete.
Newer Ghidra evidence proves native Undertexture sizes multiply DDF sizes by sqrt(2). The raw-size ground adapter in this checkpoint is superseded evidence, pending the next correction.
No browser interaction, Internet multiplayer or physical macOS execution was tested for this checkpoint.
Imported media are local-only in the portable package and excluded from the GitHub source payload.
